cases.title: Every moment is in the Outbox
steps: Read the entries for this document from the bottom up
expected: "sent" to the sender, "your turn" to each signer, "signed" to the sender for each signature, and "completed" to the sender and every signer
Each entry shows recipient, subject, text and time
"completed" entries for signers open their download page

cases.title: Fix a wrong email and resend
preconditions: A document sent with person_b's email typed as wrong_email
steps: On the newest "your turn" entry to wrong_email, click "Edit email / Resend"
Replace the email with person_b's correct email
expected: A new "your turn" entry to the correct email appears at the top
The old entry now says "This link was replaced by a newer one (the email was changed)."
Opening the old link shows "This signing link is not valid"; the new link opens the signing page
The Status page shows the corrected email

cases.title: Send a reminder
steps: On the newest "your turn" entry, click "Edit email / Resend"
expected: A new entry "Reminder: please sign …" appears with the same link
Only the newest entry for that person offers "Edit email / Resend"

cases.title: No resend once signed
steps: Look at that recipient's "your turn" entries
expected: None of them offers "Edit email / Resend"

cases.title: Inbox shows status and progress
preconditions: At least one draft, one sent and one completed document
expected: Each row shows file name, upload time, status (draft / sent / completed) and "x of y signed"
Clicking a draft opens Review; clicking a sent or completed one opens Status

cases.title: Delete a sent document
preconditions: A sent document whose signing link you have copied
expected: The dialog warns that signing links will stop working
The link shows "This signing link is not valid"

cases.title: Status page follows progress
preconditions: SEND-04 done (you are a signer and haven't signed yet)
steps: Go to the document's Status page
expected: After: your row says "Signed" with the time; the page updates by itself while others sign
